definitions.hq_branches: top 10 branches by H_j = mean top-3 branch-specific E_dj
definitions.light_collision: same whole-query binary support mask + same rare-term mask + same dominant branch + same query-projected residual sign signature
definitions.full_collision: same support/rare masks + same dominant branch + identical full 16-coordinate residual (term,sign) code
definitions.near4d: Euclidean distance after per-query min-max normalization of [tail, IDF^2 lexical+coordination, semantic support, rare3 coverage]
